caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparisons of four different prompts—V1, V2, V3, and V4—used in the HDM model for humour translation, evaluated on the basis of coherency as measured by the GEMBA-SQM score. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 86 to 100 in increments of 2, while the horizontal axis lists the four prompts. Each prompt is represented by a distinct colored bar: V1 (blue), V2 (orange), V3 (green), and V4 (purple). The scores for each prompt are as follows: V1 achieves a score of 93.69, V2 achieves 93.8, V3 achieves the highest score of 94.5, and V4 achieves 91.1. The bars are arranged in ascending order of their scores from left to right, with V3 being the tallest, indicating the best performance in coherency among the four prompts.
